newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: SOCCER-FOREST'S JERKAN JOINS RAPID ON LOAN FOR A YEAR.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FOREST'S JERKAN JOINS RAPID ON LOAN FOR A YEAR.

text.p: Croatian international defender Nikola Jerkan has joined Rapid Vienna on loan for a year from English first division Nottingham Forest, Rapid club officials said on Thursday.
Jerkan, capped 32 times, formerly played for NK Zagreb, Vinkovci and Hajduk Split before moving to Oviedo in Spain.
He joined Forest for one million pounds ($1.6 million) after the 1996 European championships but made only 14 appearances as the club were relegated from the premier league.
He could make his debut for the 1996 European Cup Winners' Cup runners-up in Friday's first division match against Austria Vienna.
*Rapid's Czech forward Rene Wagner underwent surgery on Thursday for a torn cruciate ligament sustained in Tuesday's UEFA Cup preliminary round match against his former club Boby Brno.
Wagner, Austria's top lscorer last season, will be sidelined for at least six months.
